clue.text: The sporting event with most races?

definitions.text: The sporting event with most races?

blocks.clueFragment: The sporting event with most races?
blocks.note: surface reading: a meeting with more running or horse races on the card than any other
setter's reading: races are peoples and nations, and this football tournament gathers teams from the greatest number of countries

explanation.walkthrough: Races suggests athletics or horse racing; the setter means races of people, as in nations competing.
explanation.definitionFit: Football's global tournament brings together national teams from every continent, so it features more nations than any other event.

clue.text: Sound of animal at home in fair

indicators.note: one thing in another sits inside it

blocks.note: OK means fair or satisfactory
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: A farm animal makes noises while staying in at a country fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Oink is the noise a pig makes, so it is the sound of a particular farm animal.

clue.text: Vital factor in biographical work on family

indicators.note: in a down answer, one part on another sits above it

blocks.note: a life is a biography
blood means kin or lineage, as in blood relations

explanation.surface: A key element in writing a biography is the subject's family background.
explanation.definitionFit: Lifeblood is the indispensable element that keeps something going, as blood keeps a body alive.

clue.text: Acclaims your good health!

blocks.note: first meaning: shouts approval for
second meaning: the toast said when raising a glass

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for applauding with shouts, and also the everyday toast before drinking together.

clue.text: Change from time to time? Regressively so

definitions.note: describes the act; the answer is the verb phrase for returning to old ways

blocks.note: first meaning: switching from summer time to winter time each autumn
second meaning: to return to an earlier, outdated state of affairs

explanation.walkthrough: From time to time looks like occasionally; it means from one time zone setting to another, as when clocks change in autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning the clock's hands back an hour ends daylight saving, and figuratively means reverting to older ways.

clue.text: Run into group for early meal

indicators.note: one thing going into another means it is placed inside it

blocks.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run
a bunch is a group of people or things

explanation.surface: Someone jogs over to join their friends for a morning meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A late breakfast combined with lunch, eaten earlier in the day than a normal midday meal.

clue.text: Naughty girl's intent to deceive

blocks.note: a naughty child is bad
Faith is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A mischievous young woman plans to trick someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in bad faith means dealing dishonestly while pretending sincerity, a legal phrase for deceitful intention.

clue.text: Huge range of topless pictures

indicators.note: topless in a down answer means the top letter is removed

blocks.note: murals are pictures painted on walls

explanation.surface: A big collection of photos of bare-chested models.
explanation.walkthrough: Topless suggests racy photos; here it simply drops the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The Urals are a long mountain chain in Russia, traditionally dividing Europe from Asia.

clue.text: Scenario of a film that's never cut

definitions.note: describes the quality; the answer is the noun for being unbroken

blocks.note: first meaning: the detailed shooting script used in film-making
second meaning: the state of being unbroken

explanation.walkthrough: Cut sounds like film editing, but here it simply means interrupted.
explanation.definitionFit: A continuity script sets out each scene of a film, and the word also means uninterrupted succession without breaks.

clue.text: Not influenced, as is natural

blocks.note: first meaning: left unchanged by some outside force
second meaning: without pretence or airs

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both untouched by an outside influence and sincere, free of any put-on manner or pretension.

clue.text: Arranged odd pieces as composer

indicators.note: odd pieces are the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the word

blocks.note: the letters in odd positions of this word

explanation.surface: Someone sorted miscellaneous items while working as a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: Arranged looks like an anagram signal, and composers arrange music, but the word is the source of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Arne was an eighteenth-century English composer, best known for writing Rule, Britannia!

clue.text: Nothing to wear but diamonds, perhaps, on anniversary

indicators.note: in an across answer, one part on another means it follows that other part

blocks.note: a birthday is the yearly anniversary of being born
diamonds is one example of a suit of playing cards

explanation.surface: Someone receives only diamond jewellery as an anniversary present, and has nothing else to put on.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in one's birthday suit is a jokey idiom for being naked, wearing only the skin one was born in.

clue.text: Novel fish taken to harbour

indicators.note: one part taken to another is brought up beside it and joined on

blocks.note: the bleak is a small freshwater fish
to harbour someone is to shelter or house them

explanation.surface: A catch of fish is carried to the port.
explanation.walkthrough: Harbour looks like a noun for a port; it is the verb meaning shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleak House is a Charles Dickens novel about the endless Jarndyce and Jarndyce lawsuit.

clue.text: Muse about painting's return

indicators.note: something on its return comes back the way it went, so the word is read in the opposite direction

blocks.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
an oil is a painting done in oil paints

explanation.surface: Someone muses on a painting coming back to a gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: Muse looks like a verb meaning ponder; capitalised, it is one of the nine goddesses.
explanation.definitionFit: Clio is the Muse of history in Greek mythology, one of the nine daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne.

clue.text: Style I strongly recommend? Stop that!

blocks.note: the cut of a garment or haircut is its style
taken as written
to tout something is to push or recommend it hard

explanation.surface: A fashion adviser pushes a look, and someone tells them to quit it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exasperated commands telling someone to cease what they are doing at once.

clue.text: A huge number you once found on the beach

indicators.note: in a down answer, one part on another sits above it

blocks.note: thou is the old form of you
the sands are a beach

explanation.surface: Someone once found a vast quantity of something lying on the seashore.
explanation.definitionFit: Thousands is an informal way of saying a very large quantity, many more than can be counted easily.

clue.text: Bitter complaint as Jack put up one simple notice

indicators.note: in a down answer, put up means written upwards, so the words are read from bottom to top

blocks.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in a pack of cards
I is the Roman numeral for one
mere means simple, nothing more than
an ad is a notice or advertisement

explanation.surface: A grievance arises when Jack puts up a plain sign.
explanation.definitionFit: A jeremiad is a long, mournful lament or tirade, named after the prophet Jeremiah and his Lamentations.

clue.text: Agonised after explosion in US city

indicators.note: after an explosion things lie scattered in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: People in an American city were in agony after a blast.
explanation.definitionFit: San Diego is a large Californian city on the Pacific coast near the Mexican border.

clue.text: Bad language not altogether taboo at home

indicators.note: not altogether means only part of the following words is used

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of the first word, the whole second word and the start of the third

explanation.surface: Swearing is not entirely forbidden in this household.
explanation.definitionFit: An oath can be a swear word or curse, so oaths together amount to profanity.

clue.text: For each child is an individual

blocks.note: per means for each, as in miles per hour
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: Every child is a unique human being.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words refer to a single human being considered as distinct from others.

clue.text: Low joints for workers? That's ideal

blocks.note: first meaning, whimsical: worker bees have leg joints near the ground
second meaning: a slang phrase for something excellent

explanation.walkthrough: Workers are worker bees, a crossword favourite, and the low joints are their knees.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is old slang for something first-rate, the very best, so it names the ideal thing.

clue.text: It's regularly hit by player in rare sort of game

blocks.note: first meaning: a small drum struck by a percussionist
second meaning: a scarce forest antelope of Africa

explanation.walkthrough: Game suggests a sport played by the player; it means wild animals that are hunted.
explanation.definitionFit: Bongos are hand drums played in pairs, and the bongo is also an uncommon striped African antelope.

clue.text: Score so many fours

blocks.note: surface reading: a batsman hitting a lot of boundaries in cricket
setter's reading: a score is twenty, and the answer is how many fours make it

explanation.walkthrough: Score and fours suggest cricket, where a four is a boundary; it is plain arithmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: A score means twenty, and twenty divided by four gives this number.

clue.text: Beset by sudden demand, I collapse

indicators.note: something beset by another is surrounded on all sides by it

blocks.note: a run on a bank is a sudden demand by customers for their money
taken as written

explanation.surface: Overwhelmed by sudden pressing requests, someone breaks down.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin as a noun is the downfall or collapse of a person, business or building.

clue.text: Not present for Latin class

blocks.note: surface reading: a pupil who skips a Latin lesson
setter's reading: the answer is the Latin way of saying someone is not present

explanation.walkthrough: The truant from a Latin lesson suggests a school; the clue wants the Latin phrase itself.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin phrase, used in law and ceremonies, describes something done while the person concerned is away.

clue.text: Behind one's back

blocks.note: first meaning: coming next after number one
to support a proposal or person

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as the idiom behind one's back, meaning secretly; split it after one.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the ordinal after first, and as a verb means to support a motion formally in a meeting.

clue.text: Writer given royal land

blocks.note: the king's, belonging to the monarch
a ley is a piece of grassland or meadow

explanation.surface: An author receives an estate from the Crown.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Kingsley wrote The Water-Babies, and Kingsley Amis wrote Lucky Jim; either fits the general word for an author.
